title: Alex - Senior Developer Interview
key_points: Purpose of the meeting: Mark interviews Alex, a senior developer, to assess fit for an Armstrong Fluid Technologies role.
Alex's recent experience included AWS ECS, Lambda, RDS Postgres, Redis, Node.js, Golang, and Python.
The role needs a senior developer who can understand legacy .NET intent and build Python/API bridges into the AWS SaaS platform.
Alex confirmed strong .NET credentials and comfort with Python over JavaScript.
Alex proposed using AI agents to analyze legacy .NET code and generate reports, with human oversight for hallucinations.
Next step: Mark to coordinate with Ali for a follow-up interview.

title: Technical Writer Interview - Andy
key_points: Andy brings 26 years of technical writing experience, primarily in enterprise and financial software, with relevant Rockwell hardware documentation work.
At Rockwell, Andy worked on PLC cabinet manuals and site documentation, including CAD drawings.
The role is to rewrite or update engineering manuals into proper product manuals for technical and non-technical audiences.
Likely tooling is FrameMaker; Andy confirmed strong FrameMaker experience.
Engagement could start project-by-project through Andy's company and move to full-time contract if initial work goes well.
Next step: interview with Roman, with Andy's portfolio and resume forwarded in advance.

title: Shreegant - Data Engineer Interview
key_points: Shreegant is working at Warner Brothers on data clean rooms projects using Snowflake and AWS Data Clean Rooms.
Prior Amazon experience spans Audible and Alexa, with hands-on work feeding ML models and building large-scale data pipelines.
AWS and Snowflake are primary strengths; Azure exposure is weaker.
Audible project involved multi-layer pipelines for hundreds of millions of customers and 800-900 million daily app session records.
The enterprise role required stronger .NET and Azure legacy-system experience than Shreegant had.
Recommendation was to redirect Shreegant toward the backend cloud team's upcoming data engineer role.

action_items.title: Ronali to contact Shreegant in two to three weeks for the backend cloud data engineer role.

title: Technical Screen - Carlito
key_points: Carlito's core stack is C#, .NET, Python, React, ASP.NET, and Python-based test automation.
Motivation for leaving Legend is a desire for work with more positive societal impact.
Legend work included data pipelines calling third-party REST APIs, ingesting JSON/XML, normalizing via RabbitMQ, and storing in PostgreSQL.
Carlito uses local Ollama/Llama for code template generation, test data, and unit tests, while noting proprietary-code security concerns.
Systems design and enterprise-to-cloud architecture thinking were identified as key skills for the Armstrong role.
Next step was a technical interview with a global architect focused on deep systems design.

action_items.title: Carlito to follow up with Suman if he has additional questions.

title: Candidate Screen - Namita
key_points: Namita's most recent role was Service Business Leader at Honeywell, with full P&L accountability for a 15M+ portfolio across P3 healthcare contracts.
Sourcing and vendor consolidation initiatives delivered significant margin gains.
Namita has roots in power and utilities and wants to return to that sector.
She wants cross-functional enterprise-level work focused on execution and operational improvement.
Target companies included ABB, Alstom, Eaton, GE Vernova, Schneider competitors in Canada, solar, and battery storage.
Mark confirmed Namita as a quality candidate and committed to putting out feelers with Tyler.

action_items.title: Mark to work with Tyler to put feelers out to target companies on Namita's behalf.

key_points: Purpose: Mark interviews Hussein, an OT/IoT architecture candidate, for a senior architect role at Armstrong Fluid Technologies.

Compensation expectations aligned: 200K base full-time or 130/hour contract.
